description_short.value: Ghanaian maker of alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, known for Alomo Bitters, listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange through a GHS 700 million IPO in June 2026.
description_short.source: Written by us from GSE PR 258/2026 (Kasapreko PLC completes oversubscribed initial public offer) and the Kasapreko PLC 2025 Annual Report (GSE PR 097/2026, directors' report)

description_full.value: Kasapreko PLC manufactures and distributes alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. Founded in 1989, it is best known for Alomo Bitters, a herbal alcoholic drink, and its range also includes whisky, gin, wine, soft drinks and drinking water, sold in Ghana and abroad. Before listing it was wholly owned by Pinnacle Holding Company Ltd, which held 3.55 billion shares, about 86% of the enlarged share capital after the IPO. Its founder, Dr. Kwabena Adjei, sits on the board. It had already raised money on the Ghana Fixed Income Market through a note programme before it floated its shares. In its initial public offer, which closed on 1 June 2026, it issued 583,333,333 new shares at GHS 1.20, raising GHS 700 million. The offer was 146% oversubscribed by 18,781 applicants, and the shares began trading on 15 June 2026. Revenue grew from GHS 945 million in 2021 to GHS 3.5 billion in 2025, and profit after tax reached GHS 354 million in 2025 after a loss in 2022. It has paid no dividend in the last five years; its note programme bars dividends for 2024 to 2026 unless noteholders waive the restriction. Its head office is off the Spintex Road at Baatsona, Accra.
